1. Introduction 
Sharp eTerminal is a Gespage software module dedicated to Sharp MFPs. This module uses the 
integrated touch screen of the MFP. 
 
This module enables an authentication at the MFP to provide the following functions: 
- 
Secured release at the printer (Print@me) 
- 
Tracking of the copying and scanning 
- 
Functionality of home scan to email 
- 
Access rights limitation to the MFP functions. 
 
Authentication on the MFP may be carried out by keypad or card.

Gespage eTerminal Sharp 
 
Gespage eTerminal Sharp Manual - 002 
 
6 
1.1 Compatibility 
Gespage eTerminal is compatible with all Sharp MFPs fitted with a touch screen, from OSA 3.5 
versions. The MFP must have the AMX3 licence. 
 
Sharp eTerminal does not support 480x272 screens on the non-touch MFPs.

When configuring your MFP via the web interface, it is recommended to check that the MFP is not

2.2 Gespage configuration 
2.2.1 General 
2.2.1.1 
Global parameters 
Gespage server (IP or name) address has to be checked in the global parameters of the server 
(Server/ Global Parameters) to make the dialogue possible between eTerminals and Gespage server. 

Make sure that the licences wished are available. From Server / Support / Licence, information about 
your Gespage Server and the licenses bought are available. An eTerminal can be installed only if you 
have the Sharp eTerminal associated license or if your server is in demo mode. 

After supply, a new licence is saved by just uploading and validating. 
2.2.1.2 
Networks flows 
Sharp eTerminal communicates with Gespage service on the TCP ports 7180/7181.

configuration 
Sharp eTerminal being automatically saved on Gespage server, it is accessible by moving to Printers / 
Terminals / List of Terminals. Your eTerminals will be in « Sharp » tab. 

By clicking on your eTerminal, you can edit its features. 
 
Name 
The name of the Terminal must be filled in. The name is free but 2 identical names cannot be 
entered. 
MFP address 
The address of the MFP is the IP address of the MFP on which the eTerminal is installed. 
ATTENTION! The identifier of your MFP is its IP address. The IP address of your MFP must not 
change, otherwise a new eTerminal will be saved and the former will become obsolete. 
Comments 
Comment of the eTerminal in Gespage. Comments are optional. 
Reader profile 
Name of a reader profile associated with the card reader (see Gespage manual). 
The reader profile is an advanced setting useful when non-standard card readers have to be 
connected or when the numbers of the cards stored on Gespage do not match the standard 
format. 
Print job release 
Indicates whether printings sent to the MFP are locked as long as the user is not identified.

Gespage account. This association only applies at the first card insertion. 
1.

keyboard at the login screen. The card self-association will be required only once during the

2. 
Done by the administrator 
All card numbers of users have to first be configured in Gespage. The initialization can be 
carried out by the administrator or by the LDAP synchronization mechanism.

direct access to his pending prints, he has to go to « Home » for moving to another service. 

Disconnection is made via the red button at the top right of Gespage screen or the exit door on Sharp 
screen or by passing a card.

3.1.4 Scan to e-mail 
The eTerminal automatically configures the email of the user when he is authenticated on the MFP. 
Scans can therefore be made and sent directly to the personal e-mail of the user. 
 
After being entered in « E-Mail » service, choose « Send E-mail to oneself ». 
 
Choose E-Mail: 

The user e-mail appears automatically, it only remains to make the scan and then send the e-mail. 
 
ATTENTION! This feature is not available on all Sharp MFPs.
